versions.title: Smart Vision & Popup Recovery
notes: Added per-slot Popup Recovery: upload a confirmation-dialog image, select its screen area, record a confirm/recovery action, and let the slot handle that popup automatically before resuming.
Popup detection pauses normal slot playback, runs the recorded recovery action once, uses cooldown protection, and continues watching briefly after a slot finishes for delayed dialogs.
Enhanced custom target recognition with a three-channel Smart Vision score combining grayscale structure, full-colour appearance, and edge/text-shape detail.
Added scale-tolerant matching for custom targets, with a default plus/minus 6 percent tolerance, a configurable match threshold, and clearer live detection diagnostics.
Text inside uploaded templates is matched visually from letter shapes and edges; this is visual template recognition rather than semantic OCR.
Refreshed the interface with a newer Automation Studio dashboard, cleaner cards, modern cyan/pink accents, improved status hierarchy, and clearer setup guidance.
Retained all 10 sequence slots, optional keyboard recording, v15 Low-Impact Game Engine, per-slot deactivation, and the v16.2 in-app recording countdown.

versions.title: Universal Roblox Target Engine
notes: Renamed the app to Roblox Auto Roll Selector and removed Idle Mafia-specific branding from the current interface.
Added custom target-image uploads so you can roll for any visual result in any Roblox game instead of being limited to built-in rarity names.
Single-macro mode can use an uploaded PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP or BMP target image with the existing selectable detection area and match threshold.
Every sequence slot can use its own uploaded CUSTOM target image, its own detection area and its own recorded macro.
Expanded Sequence Mode from five to ten independent macro + target-area slots; existing slots 1-5 migrate forward automatically.
Added optional keyboard recording alongside mouse recording, including key-down/key-up timing, held-key duration, repeat filtering and safe key release when a macro stops.
Legacy BOTH / SECRET / MYTHIC targets remain available for existing Idle Mafia setups.
Retained the v15 Low-Impact Game Engine, v16 sequence deactivation behavior and the v16.2 in-app recording countdown.

versions.title: In-App Recording Countdown
notes: Removed the floating recording-countdown overlay that caused issues.
The app now stays fully visible while a macro recording countdown is running.
The existing Engine status corner shows REC 2.0s, REC 1.9s and so on in tenths of a second, then changes to RECORDING only when mouse capture is actually live.
The recording-start confirmation now clearly says the app will stay open during the countdown.
The in-app countdown works for the normal single-macro recorder and all five Sequence Mode macro slots.
Sequence logic, v15 Low-Impact Game Engine, exact absolute mouse coordinates, rarity detection and saved recordings are unchanged.

versions.title: Five-Slot Sequence Engine
notes: Added Sequence Mode with up to five independent macro + rarity-area pairs.
Each slot stores its own recorded absolute-coordinate mouse macro, rarity area, enabled state and SECRET / MYTHIC / BOTH target.
The controller rotates through active slots in order: Macro 1 + Area 1, Macro 2 + Area 2, through Macro 5 + Area 5.
If a slot detects its selected rarity, only that slot is immediately deactivated and the rest of the sequence continues.
Rare slot deactivation persists until you manually reactivate that slot, so the next sequence pass automatically skips it.
Added per-slot Record Macro, Set Rarity Area, Test Detection, Reactivate and Clear controls plus sequence status badges.
Added configurable pre-check and final-result scan windows so an already-visible rare is protected before a macro can dismiss it and new results get a final detection window.
The v15 Low-Impact Game Engine, Game Compatibility Mode, exact recorded anchor coordinates, click reliability improvements and legacy single-macro mode are retained.

versions.title: Low-Impact Game Engine
notes: Added Game Compatibility Mode to reduce CPU, GPU, and input overhead while Roblox is running.
Reduced detector load from the old ~83 scans/sec default to about 33 scans/sec in compatibility mode and lowered the detector thread priority.
Capped generated smooth movement at 120 Hz in compatibility mode, re-enabled Windows movement coalescing, and removed redundant generated movement events.
Reworked high-precision timing so the app sleeps for most waits instead of continuously yielding/spinning near every mouse event.
Improved click reliability with a configurable hover-settle delay and minimum mouse-button hold time so Roblox has time to register hover and clicks.
Reduced UI animation, analytics, logging, callbacks, and sound work while a macro is actively replaying.
OpenCV now uses one CPU thread and disables OpenCL for the small rarity-detection crop to reduce contention with the game.
Existing recorded absolute mouse anchors, rare-stop behavior, settings, recordings, and version rollback remain compatible.

versions.title: Windows Taskbar Icon Fix
notes: Fixed the app icon not appearing correctly on the Windows taskbar.
The app now sets its Windows AppUserModelID before Tk creates the window.
Added native WM_SETICON handling for both the small and large window icons, including the true root HWND.
Added a generated multi-size ICO fallback and repeats the native icon assignment after the window is mapped to prevent Tk or Windows from replacing it.
Macro playback, rare detection, recordings, and settings are unchanged.

versions.title: App Icon Micro Update
notes: Added a custom app icon designed for the Idle Mafia Precision Mouse Macro.
The icon now appears in the Windows app window and replaces the IM sidebar badge.
Updated the app title to show the full version number 14.1.0.
This is a lightweight visual micro-update; macro and detector behavior are unchanged.

versions.title: Update Center
notes: Added an in-app Update Center with automatic update checks.
Update popup now offers Update Now, View Changes, or Later.
Added full version history with one-click switching and rollback.
App versions are installed side-by-side while settings and macro recordings stay in shared data.
Every downloaded update package is verified with SHA-256 before installation.
Added Stable/Beta update channel preference for future releases.
